Job Description
Your contribution to something big

You will be responsible for organizing and participating in project workshops and events 
Preparing and delivering presentations during meetings will be a key part of your responsibilities 
You will also prepare content and participate in discussions with senior management, contributing to strategic decision-making 
From a technical perspective, your work will focus heavily on model-based development using the MATLAB/Simulink environment 

Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting in March 2027 
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden 

Qualifications
What distinguishes you 
Currently studying Control and System Engineering, Computer Science, or similar (Bachelor or Master of Science) 
Ability to manage and set priorities in a changing environment  
Good analytical skills  
Ability to work independently and approach people easily  
Structured and result-oriented way of working with an ‘outside of the box’ thinking 
Working knowledge in Microsoft Office tools (esp. Excel and PowerPoint) 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English 
Ideally knowledge in Matlab/Simulink 

Additional Information

Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship 
We can offer free accommodation in Tranås  
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services

jobs.occupation: ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN
jobs.description:
TAKTEAM
SEASONAL 6-MONTH EMPLOYMENT 2027
ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN
Would you like to become part of a growing company that offers good opportunities for professional development while contributing to the sustainable maintenance and protection of our customers’ homes?
Then send your application today!
Candidate selection takes place on an ongoing basis.
JOB DESCRIPTION
As a member of our team, you will represent the company to our customers while carrying out the work. Most of the work takes place in different areas of Sweden, and you will be working outdoors, on the tiled roofs of residential properties.
Your duties will include cleaning tiled roofs and facades. This is a varied job involving many different activities and procedures. Overnight travel may also be required.
At the beginning of your employment, you will receive relevant training in the use of high-pressure cleaning equipment and in working at heights. Previous experience in these areas is, of course, an additional advantage.
The work takes place in different areas of Sweden, from the west coast to the east coast. This means that, alongside your work, you will have the opportunity to experience different parts of the country and discover Sweden from a different perspective.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
This is a physically demanding job that requires good physical ability and skill in using your body, hands, and various tools.
You will work in a two-person team responsible for roof cleaning. For this reason, we place great importance on your ability to cooperate and communicate effectively, accept and handle feedback, and, above all, be willing to work hard and pull your weight when needed.
If you have a colleague or friend who is also interested in coming to work in Sweden, we would be happy to know. The possibility of starting together can make it much easier to form a team, as two people usually work together in each team. In this way, if you come together, the team can be ready from the beginning.
Roof cleaning can involve unexpected challenges related to the surface, dimensions, and similar issues. We are therefore looking for someone who is solution-oriented, is not afraid to take initiative, and can suggest creative solutions.
Naturally, we also want you to be flexible, learn quickly, and contribute to creating a good atmosphere within your team, as well as during any contact with customers.
REQUIREMENTS FOR THE POSITION
• Good knowledge of English.
• B or BE driving licence.
ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Good knowledge of Greek.
• Experience using high-pressure washing equipment, carpentry, roof installation/construction, or similar work involving machinery.
• Experience in the construction and assembly of scaffolding.
• Experience in cleaning and painting tiled roofs, as well as cleaning and painting facades.
WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO WORK AS A ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN AT TAKTEAM?
• A high level of freedom and responsibility in your work.
• Good opportunities for professional development.
• Variety in your daily work, with different types of tasks for our customers.
• Work in different areas of Sweden.
• Accommodation provided for the duration of your employment with us. Team members share the same apartment/accommodation.
• Statutory insurance coverage.
• Good benefits and working conditions.
• Hourly-paid employment.
• Salary is paid on the 25th of each month and covers the work performed during the previous month.
Working in different areas of Sweden is not only a professional opportunity, but also a way to experience the country, visit different places, and gain new experiences.
If you are hardworking, responsible, cooperative, and eager to develop your skills within a growing company, we would be happy to receive your application!

jobs.occupation: Transplant Hepatologist Opportunity at a Renowned University Hospital
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you an experienced specialist in gastroenterology and hepatology looking for a role where you can combine advanced clinical work, collaboration with highly skilled colleagues, and excellent opportunities for professional development?
We are currently seeking a hepatologist with at least five years of experience as a specialist physician to join a highly specialized team at one of Sweden’s leading university-affiliated hospitals. This opportunity offers the chance to work with complex liver disease, transplantation medicine, and tertiary-level care in a modern and research-oriented environment.
About the department
The department is one of the largest and most specialized units within gastroenterology and hepatology in the Nordic region. It provides both emergency and elective care and works closely with several highly specialized disciplines.
You will become part of an international team of approximately ten specialist physicians with diverse professional backgrounds and areas of expertise. Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to the department's culture.
The unit manages a broad spectrum of hepatology cases, including advanced liver disease and liver transplantation, while maintaining a strong focus on clinical excellence, education, and research.
Your role
As a specialist in gastroenterology and hepatology, you will:
Assess, diagnose, and treat patients with complex liver diseases
Participate in both outpatient and inpatient hepatology care
Work closely with multidisciplinary teams involved in advanced liver treatment and transplantation
Contribute to teaching and supervision of junior colleagues and medical students
Participate in quality improvement initiatives and departmental development
Take part in on-call duties together with experienced colleagues

Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate who has:
EU-recognized specialist certification in Gastroenterology and Hepatology
At least five years of experience working as a specialist physician
Experience in hepatology and management of advanced liver diseases
Experience related to liver transplantation
Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
The ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment

Research experience, academic involvement, or a PhD is considered an advantage.
Why work here?
This opportunity combines highly specialized medicine with an excellent quality of life.
The region offers:
Easy access to coastlines, nature, and outdoor activities
A vibrant cultural scene and excellent public services
International connections and modern infrastructure
A safe and family-friendly environment
Excellent opportunities for long-term professional development

You will work in a progressive healthcare setting where innovation, education, research, and high-quality patient care are closely integrated.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Take the next step in your career
This is an excellent opportunity for experienced hepatologists with liver transplantation experience who want to work in a highly specialized and progressive environment while enjoying a high quality of life.
Don’t hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you and helping you find the perfect job that matches your experience and ambitions.
 
Application
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the final application date.
Submit your application today and include:
CV / résumé
Diploma and educational certificates/ Proof of professional license/registration
Motivation letter
References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Snickare till längre uppdrag i norra Finland
jobs.description:
Erfarna snickare sökes till längre uppdrag i norra Finland / Experienced carpenters wanted for longer assignments in northern Finland
LETA Consulting AB söker erfarna och utbildade snickare för längre uppdrag hos våra kunder i norra Finland. Har du yrkesstolthet, flera års erfarenhet och letar efter nästa steg i din karriär? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig!
Vi samarbetar med etablerade aktörer inom byggbranschen och söker nu duktiga snickare till projekt inom nyproduktion, renovering och industriella byggnationer. Uppdragen är långsiktiga och för rätt person finns goda möjligheter till fast anställning direkt hos kund.
LETA Consulting AB is looking for experienced and trained carpenters for longer assignments with our clients in northern Finland. Do you have professional pride, several years of experience, and are looking for the next step in your career? Then we would love to hear from you!
We work with established players in the construction industry and are now looking for skilled carpenters for projects in new construction, renovation, and industrial building. The assignments are long-term, and for the right person, there are good opportunities for permanent employment directly with the client.
Om tjänsten / About the job
Som snickare via LETA Consulting blir du en del av vårt kompetenta team på plats ute hos kund. Du arbetar heltid enligt finska kollektivavtal och placeras i projekt i norra Finland. Vi hjälper till med praktiska frågor såsom boende och resor, så att du kan fokusera på det du är bäst på – ditt hantverk.
As a carpenter through LETA Consulting, you become part of our skilled team on-site with the client. You work full-time according to the Finnish collective agreement and are placed in projects in northern Finland. We help with practical matters like housing and travel so you can focus on what you do best – your craft.
Vi erbjuder dig / We offer you
- Anställning enligt finska arbetsvillkor och kollektivavtal - Lön enligt avtal - Långsiktiga uppdrag hos etablerade kunder - Hjälp med boende och praktiska arrangemang - Möjlighet till övergång till kund för rätt person - Trygghet och stöd från en erfaren arbetsgivare - Start omgående och löpande
- Employment according to Finnish working conditions and collective agreements - Salary according to the agreement - Long-term assignments with established clients - Help with accommodation and practical arrangements - Opportunity to transition to the client for the right person - Security and support from an experienced employer - Immediate start and ongoing opportunities
Vi söker dig som har / We are looking for someone who has
- Yrkesbevis eller motsvarande utbildning som snickare - Gedigen erfarenhet inom byggbranschen - Självständig arbetsstil och god samarbetsförmåga - B-körkort är meriterande - Talar svenska, finska eller engelska (koncernspråket är engelska)
- A professional certificate or equivalent education as a carpenter - Solid experience in the construction industry - An independent working style and good teamwork skills - A driver's license (B) is a plus - Speaks Swedish, Finnish, or English (the company language is English)

Skicka in ditt CV via länken i annonsen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post på grund av GDPR. Sista ansökningsdag är den 30 november men vi rekryterar löpande, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt!
Submit your CV via the link in the ad. We do not accept applications by email due to GDPR. The last application date is November 30, but we are recruiting continuously, so send in your application as soon as possible!

Kontakta gärna / Feel free to contact Johan Larsson 📧 johan.larsson@letaconsulting.se  +46 76-800 23 43

jobs.occupation: À la carte kock / À la carte chef
jobs.description:
På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.
I hjärtat av Camp Ripan finner du vår fantastiska restaurang där vi erbjuder frukost, lunch och middag samt möjlighet för större arrangemang. Inspirationen är hämtad ur stadens tre kulturer – den svenska, den samiska och den tornedalsfinska och det är detta som genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Nu söker vi dig som förutom ett roligt och utmanande arbete är redo för en vintersäsong i norr med storslagen fjällvärld, magiskt norrsken och fantastiska fritidsaktiviteter. 
Som medarbetare i vårt kök på Camp Ripan är du en stor del av det som gör att gästerna får en minnesvärd matupplevelse utöver det vanliga hoa oss. Här representeras vår trekulturella region i form av noggrant utvalda råvaror i spännande smakkombinationer. Camp Ripans kök är ett av Sveriges mest klimatsmarta kök, här arbetar vi med den senaste tekniken för att minimera vår påverkan på miljön. 
Vi söker nu dig som trivs med att jobba i ett drivet arbetslag, där alla deltar och påverkar den kreativa processen, från idé till färdig produkt. Du har ett levande intresse för yrket, minst 6 års erfarenhet (3 år utbildning, 3 år av arbetslivserfarenhet i à la carterestaurang), goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska. Det är meriterande om du har kunskaper inom den lokala matkulturen och dess råvaror eftersom det är grunden i vår matfilosofi.  
Personalboende finns att tillgå vid behov. Särskild visstidsanställning på 100%. Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person för tjänsten. 
 
At Camp Ripan, you will have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by the nature and culture that make our region special. We value our employees and offer a workplace where you can grow and develop. You will become a part of a close-knit team where collaboration, service, and respect for one another are fundamental.
At the heart of Camp Ripan you find our fantastic restaurant, where we serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner, as well as hosting larger events and gatherings. Our inspiration comes from the three cultures of Kiruna – Swedish, Sámi, and Tornedalian-Finnish – which are reflected throughout our entire operation. We are now looking for someone who is ready for an exciting and challenging job, as well as the opportunity to experience a winter season in the spectacular mountain landscape, magical Northern Lights, and fantastic outdoor activities.
As a member of our kitchen team at Camp Ripan, you will play an important role in creating memorable dining experiences for our guests. Our three-cultural region is represented through carefully selected local ingredients and exciting combinations of flavors. Camp Ripan's kitchen is one of Sweden's most climate-conscious kitchens, and we use modern technology and sustainable methods to minimize our environmental impact.
We are looking for someone who enjoys working as part of a motivated kitchen team, where everyone contributes to and influences the creative process, from the initial idea to the finished dish. You have a genuine passion for the profession and at least six years of experience (three years of education and three years of professional experience in an à la carte restaurant). Good knowledge of Swedish and/or English is required. Knowledge of local food culture and regional ingredients is considered an advantage, as these form the foundation of our culinary philosophy.
Staff accommodation is available if needed. This is a full-time temporary position (100%). Interviews are conducted continuously, and employment will begin once we have found the right candidate for the position.

jobs.occupation: Breast and Melanoma Surgeon Opportunity at a Leading University Hospital
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a Specialist in General Surgery with experience and a particular interest in breast and melanoma surgery? 
Are you looking for an opportunity to develop further within specialised cancer surgery while working in a multidisciplinary and academically active environment?
We are currently recruiting a Specialist in General Surgery with experience and a strong professional interest in breast and melanoma surgery for a permanent position at a major university hospital in southwestern Sweden.
The position offers the opportunity to combine specialised clinical work with multidisciplinary cancer care, professional development, teaching and research in a highly specialised hospital environment.
About the position
Your primary focus will be the care and surgical treatment of patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma.
The role includes both outpatient care and day surgery, and you will be involved in the assessment, treatment and follow-up of patients.
The work is characterised by close multidisciplinary and multiprofessional collaboration, where surgeons work together with other specialists and healthcare professionals throughout the patient's treatment pathway.
Most of the work is carried out during daytime hours. Depending on your individual competence and previous experience, participation in general surgical on-call duties may also be included.
Breast and melanoma surgery
The position is particularly suited to a general surgeon who already has clinical experience within breast surgery, melanoma surgery or related oncological surgery and wishes to continue developing within this field.
You will work with patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma in a specialised surgical environment that combines clinical care with continuous development.
The broader surgical organisation also includes areas such as upper gastrointestinal surgery, endocrine and sarcoma surgery, as well as acute and trauma surgery.
A university hospital environment
The hospital offers an environment where specialised healthcare, education, clinical development and research are closely connected.
The breast and melanoma surgery field is research-intensive, and teaching and continuous development are natural parts of the position.
For a surgeon who wants to combine clinical expertise with continued academic and professional development, this provides an opportunity to build a long-term career within a large Swedish university hospital.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a Specialist in General Surgery who has a particular interest and relevant experience in breast and melanoma surgery.
You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary setting and are comfortable taking responsibility while contributing to the continued development of the department.
You value close collaboration with colleagues from different professions and specialties and have a patient-centred approach to your work.
Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate who:
Holds an EU-recognised specialist qualification in General Surgery
Has relevant clinical experience
Has experience and a strong professional interest in breast surgery, melanoma surgery and/or related oncological surgery
Is comfortable managing patients throughout different stages of the surgical care pathway
Enjoys working in multidisciplinary and multiprofessional teams
Has a strong sense of responsibility and an interest in clinical development
Has good communication and collaboration skills
Has good English language skills
Is strongly motivated to learn Swedish and establish a long-term career in Sweden

For candidates who do not yet speak Swedish, language training is provided as part of the recruitment process.
What the hospital offers
You will have the opportunity to:
Work within specialised breast and melanoma surgery
Develop your competence within surgical cancer care
Work with both outpatient consultations and surgical treatment
Become part of an established multidisciplinary cancer care environment
Participate in teaching and continuous clinical development
Work in a research-intensive university hospital environment
Collaborate with experienced specialists across different medical and surgical disciplines
Continue developing both clinically and academically

What Dignus Medical offers you:
• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Interested?
We look forward to hearing from you!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Finnish radiographers wanted for opportunity in Sweden
jobs.description:

Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a qualified radiographer from Finland interested in taking the next step in your career in Sweden?
We are currently recruiting two Finnish radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in a coastal community in central Sweden.
This is a long-term opportunity for someone who values modern equipment, close teamwork and a healthy work-life balance. The position offers daytime working hours only, with no evenings, nights, weekends, public holidays or on-call duties.
The department
You will become part of a smaller radiology department with approximately 10 employees, providing both planned and acute diagnostic imaging in close collaboration with inpatient care and primary care.
The facilities have recently been modernised and the department works with modern equipment, including:
Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

The team consists of radiographers, assistant nurses, a radiologist and a sonographer.
There is also close collaboration with a larger radiology department, giving you the opportunity to occasionally gain experience in an environment with a higher acute patient flow.
About the role
Your main work will be within:
CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.
Working hours are Monday to Friday, 07:30–16:00.
There are no evening or night shifts, no weekend work, no work on public holidays and no on-call duties.
Previous professional experience as a radiographer is an advantage, but not a requirement. Experience in CT and conventional radiography is particularly valuable.
Requirements
We are looking for candidates who:
Hold a radiographer qualification from Finland
Have the legal right to practise as a radiographer in Finland
Are currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Are interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Have good communication skills in English
Are motivated to learn Swedish
Are interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

Meritorious
Previous experience in CT
Previous experience in conventional radiography
Knowledge of Swedish
Swedish professional authorization

The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area offers a combination of small-town living and easy access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to someone looking for a quieter lifestyle, short distances and good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
Schools and childcare are available locally, with good transport connections to larger cities.
Swedish language training and relocation
If you do not already speak Swedish at the required level, Swedish language training is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin studying Swedish from Finland through individual online lessons with a private teacher while continuing your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After relocating, you initially work 50% as a Radiography Assistant while continuing your Swedish studies from 
B2 to C1. During this period, work takes place in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
Once you have reached the required Swedish level and obtained Swedish professional authorization, you begin working fully as a radiographer.
Salary
During the language completion phase in Sweden, while employed as a Radiography Assistant, 
the salary is: 30,800 SEK/month gross
After obtaining Swedish authorization and starting work as a Radiographer, the starting salary for a candidate without previous professional experience is: 31,100 SEK/month gross
For radiographers with previous professional experience, the salary may be individually determined based on experience and competence.
What Dignus Medical offers you
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during and after your relocation and employment
Assistance with the process of obtaining Swedish professional authorization
Help with relocation and accommodation
Support for your family if needed
Free Swedish language training with a private online tutor

Interested in working as a radiographer in Sweden?
We look forward to hearing from you!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Permanent nursing positions in Jondal, Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Jondal, Western Norway.
You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.
Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.
About the position
As a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.
The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Your responsibilities will include:
Providing nursing care and following up patients
Clinical observation, assessment and documentation
Medication management and treatment
Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes
Making independent clinical assessments
Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare service

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.
You:
Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country
Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country
Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work
Hold a valid driving licence
Work well both independently and as part of a team
Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care services

We help you prepare for working in Norway
You do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.
We provide:
Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher
Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals
Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation
Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work
Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway
Personal follow-up before, during and after your move

The language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.
What you can expect in Jondal
A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system
Varied work across nursing home and home care services
The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills
Independent professional responsibility
Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
The opportunity to follow patients over time
Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangements

Life between the fjord, mountains and glacier
Jondal is located in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.
Nature is part of everyday life here. After work, you can hike in the mountains, kayak or fish on the fjord, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. In winter, the area offers excellent opportunities for skiing and other outdoor activities.
Despite its small size, Jondal has the essentials you need for everyday life, including a grocery store, places to eat and local cultural and leisure activities. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities. Odda is around 40 minutes away by car, while Bergen offers a larger city environment and an international airport.
Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?
Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

jobs.occupation: Specialist in General Surgery - Nordic Island
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Have you been considering a career change but have not yet found the right opportunity?
Are you looking for a position where you can work across a broad range of surgery, take responsibility, and at the same time enjoy a healthy work-life balance? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
We are looking for a Specialist in General Surgery to join a smaller acute care hospital located on a Nordic island in a unique setting. Here, you will have the opportunity to work broadly within surgery and become an important part of a close-knit clinical team.
About the position
The surgical department offers a broad scope of practice and is not divided into narrow subspecialty sections. This means you will work with a varied patient population and have the opportunity to use a wide range of your surgical skills.
The work includes gastrointestinal surgery, gallbladder and hernia surgery, colorectal surgery, proctology, endoscopy and acute surgery. Both open and laparoscopic surgery are performed.
Endoscopy is a natural part of the surgical practice and includes both gastroscopy and colonoscopy.
Working at a smaller acute care hospital means that the working day can vary considerably. You should therefore enjoy a broad surgical role and feel confident assessing and managing a range of surgical conditions.
Close collaboration and a supportive team
As a surgeon, you will become an important part of a smaller team where colleagues work closely together and support one another. Collegial support and guidance are available when needed.
We are not looking for someone who is expected to know everything. What matters is that you have broad surgical competence, sound clinical judgement, and the confidence to recognise when you may need support or wish to further develop your skills in a particular area.
The smaller hospital setting also gives you the opportunity to contribute your experience and play an active role in the continued development of the department.
Work-life balance
The position is located in a unique Nordic island environment, surrounded by the sea, archipelago and nature. It offers an attractive alternative for those seeking a different lifestyle from what is often associated with working at a large regional or university hospital.
For those who value both a professionally rewarding career and time for family, leisure and recovery, the location offers an attractive combination.
Qualifications
We are looking for a specialist who:
Holds an EU-recognised specialist qualification in General Surgery
Has broad surgical competence and experience
Has experience in gastrointestinal and acute surgery
Has experience in endoscopy, particularly gastroscopy
Is comfortable working both independently and as part of a team
Has good collaboration skills and a patient-centred approach
Is flexible and appreciates the variety that comes with working at a smaller acute care hospital
Has good English language skills
Has a strong motivation to learn Swedish. Language training is provided.

Experience in additional areas of surgery is considered an advantage.
Who are you?
You are a Specialist in General Surgery who appreciates the breadth of the specialty and enjoys working in a smaller clinical environment where collaboration, flexibility and responsibility are a natural part of everyday work.
You are confident in your professional role, collaborative and open-minded. You value being part of a close-knit team where colleagues support one another and where your experience and expertise can make a meaningful contribution to both the department and its patients.
You are also motivated to continue developing professionally and are happy to share your own knowledge and experience with colleagues.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the position.
We look forward to hearing from you!
